MCCLX.title: Master Cyclotomic Identity
MCCLX.statement: W(3,3) substrate = {Phi_n(q) : n | 12} evaluated at q=3
MCCLX.key_insight: The divisors of 12 index both the cyclotomic factors of Q(zeta_12)/Q AND the substrate primitives of W(3,3). The Langlands ring Z[zeta_12] is the algebraic NECESSITY of the theory.
